sentences.text: 4. The office has placed both the matters before this Court with its office report dated 01.05.2024 stating that in compliance of the Administrative Order dated 5.12.2018 of Hon'ble The Chief Justice the matters are to be heard by this Bench.
The matters are thus before this Bench.

5. This application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant- Kanti Kumar Singh @ Biru with the following prayer:-
"It, is therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and direct the learned Court below to decide the Session Trial No. 34 of 2016 (State of U.P. Vs. Kanti Singh) arising out of Case Crime No. 17 of 2016 u/s 363, 302, 201, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act in Police Station- Kaptanganj, District- Azamgarh, pending before Additional Session Judge/Special Judge (POCSO) Azamgarh within some stipulated period.

entities.text: State of U.P. Vs. Kanti Singh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may very pleased to direct the learned Court below to decide the application of the applicant dated 14.02.2024 bearing Paper No. 66-Kha pending before the learned Additional Session Judge/Special Judge (POCSO), Azamgarh within some stipulated period and/or pass such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case, otherwise the applicant will suffer irreparable loss and injury."
6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is the accused of the present case who is in jail since 03.02.2016.

It is submitted that the present trial is pending since the year 2016 and after conclusion of final argument by the trial court vide order dated 27.07.2023, the matter was directed to be listed for delivery of judgement on 10.08.2023.
On 10.08.2023 since the Steno of the court concerned was not available the judgement could not be pronounced and the matter was adjourned.

Subsequently vide order dated 11.08.2023 the matter was again directed to be listed for arguments of the prosecution and since then the matter is at the said stage and in between a transfer application has been filed by the opposite party no.2.

It is submitted that the trial is pending without Kanti Kumar Singh @ Biru vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79751472/
2 any progress and is being delayed without any justifiable reason.

sentences.text:
7. Perused the records and heard learned counsels for the parties.
8.

The order-sheet dated 27.07.2023 shows that the arguments in the matter concluded and the matter was posted for delivery of judgement on 10.08.2023 which then could not be delivered on the said date since as per the order-sheet the Clerk was on leave and the court observed that there were some points on which the prosecution argument was needed to be heard.
Since then the matter is lingering on.
9. It is provided that the trial of the present case be taken up by the concerned trial court and concluded at the earliest on a day to day basis.
10. The petition is allowed.
Order on Transfer Application No. 767 of 2023 1.

Heard Sri Chandrajeet Yadav, Advocate holding brief of Sri Jagadish Prasad Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Neelabh Srivastava, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Bade Lal Bind, learned counsel for the State and perused the records.

2. This transfer application under Section 407 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant- Buddhu Gupta with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow the present transfer application and transfer the Special Session Trial No. 34 of 2016 (State Vs. Kranti Singh) arising out of Case Crime No. 17 of 2016,
Under Section 363, 302, 201 & 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Kaptanganj, District- Azamgarh pending in the Court of POCSO Court, Azamgarh to the competent jurisdiction of District Court, Azamgarh or any other district of U.P. by quashing the order dated 22.11.2023 passed by Sessions Judge, Azamgarh in the interest of justice, so that the applicant may appear and contest the case.

entities.text: Special Session Trial No. 34 of 2016 (State Vs. Kranti Singh)

sentences.text: And/or to pass such other and further order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstance of the case, otherwise the applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."
3. The applicant is the complainant of the present case.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present transfer application be dismissed as not pressed.
5. As prayed, the present transfer application is dismissed as not pressed.
